title: Arma Reforger: Deluxe Edition – v1.9.0.37 + 4 DLCs/Bonuses
description:
Arma Reforger is the latest installment in the legendary Arma franchise, offering a versatile, creative, and fully-moddable platform that redefines the mil-sim genre.

Experience enthralling multiplayer combat in matches that can last anywhere from an hour to days in the Conflict game mode or create your own missions and curate them in real time in Game Master. Team up with friends in Combat Ops to engage in special operations, or ramp up the adrenaline with the fast-paced, tactical gameplay of Capture & Hold. For the lone wolves out there, the new single-player campaign Operation Omega features 5 replayable missions, and the additional scenarios Elimination and Air Support offer hours of intense and immersive gameplay.

From the distinct crack of an M16 to the rumble of a BTR-70, every element of Arma Reforger is designed for authenticity. Engage in realistic firefights with detailed ballistics, navigate using only a map and compass, and master a roster of meticulously recreated Cold War-era weapons and vehicles.

Deploy to three vast and intricately detailed islands for thrilling and immersive open-world military operations. Featuring stunning landscapes with lush forests, idyllic towns, and austere mountains, these islands provide the perfect backdrop for the wide range of PvP, co-op, and single-player game modes available in Arma Reforger.

The war expands with the addition of Kolguyev, the iconic island first introduced in Arma: Cold War Assault. Navigate through the desolate ruins of former mining operations, infiltrate secret military installations, and immerse yourself in Kolguyev’s unique atmosphere in the brand-new single-player campaign set in 1989.

Instantly download and install thousands of community-made mods from the in-game Workshop. With an endless variety of time periods and genres, Arma Reforger mods open up a vast universe of weapons, vehicles, assets, terrains, game mechanics, and even completely new game modes to customize your experience to suit your preferred play style.

title: Prince of Persia: The Two Thrones
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: December 7, 2005
- **Genre**: Action - TPP - Fantasy
- **Developer**: Ubisoft Montreal
- **Publisher**: Ubisoft

## Overview
The Prince of Persia makes his way home to Babylon, bearing with him Kaileena, the enigmatic Empress of Time. Instead of the peace he longs for, he finds his kingdom ravaged by war and Kaileena the target of a brutal plot. When she is kidnapped and killed, her death unleashes the Sands of Time, which strike the Prince and threaten to destroy everything he holds dear. Cast to the streets, hunted as a fugitive, the Prince discovers that the Sands have tainted him giving rise to a deadly Dark Prince, whose spirit gradually possesses our hero.

## Features
- Master two very different characters as you engage enemies with the improved free-form fighting system.
- Strangle foes with the Daggertail or use new stealth skills to launch deadly attacks from the shadows.
- Explore astonishing, varied locations, find your way into seemingly unreachable areas, and solve many twisted puzzles.
- Expanded free-form fighting complete with stealth and ranged attacks for finesse and complexity.
- An amazing story full of twists and heart-stopping moments.
- Beautiful, diverse world to explore, including the streets of Babylon and the famous Hanging Gardens.

title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: January 19, 2003
- **Genre**: Action - Simulation - Stealth
- **Developer**: Ubisoft Montreal
- **Publisher**: Ubisoft

## Overview
The player takes on the role of Sam Fisher, an operative for the National Security Agency's sub agency, the Third Echelon—a secret cell that is never recognized by the U.S. government. Fisher is sent to T'Bilisi, Georgia, to find missing CIA agents investigating communications blackouts. He infiltrates the Georgian government to unveil a threat that could have devastating consequences for the American people.

## Features
- Stealth-oriented action gameplay in a Tom Clancy-inspired landscape.
- High-tech gadgets including night vision, thermal vision, EM sensors, and sticky cams.
- Wide array of weapons including suppressed pistols, assault rifles, sticky shock bombs, and Ring-Airfoil Projectiles.
- Mechanics for climbing, mantling, and sneaking.
- Includes Mission Pack with three additional missions: the original Kola Cell mission, Vselka Infiltration, and Vselka Submarine.

title: Fallout
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: September 30, 1997
- **Genre**: Role-playing - Turn-based - Sci-fi
- **Developer**: Interplay
- **Publisher**: Interplay / Bethesda Softworks LLC

## Overview
Set in the aftermath of a world-wide nuclear war, Fallout challenges you to survive in an unknown and dangerous world. You will take the role of a Vault-dweller, a person who has grown up in a secluded, underground survival Vault. Circumstances arise that force you to go Outside to a strange world 80 years after the end of modern civilization—a world of mutants, radiation, gangs and violence. Your immediate task is to find a replacement for the broken water purification controller chip to save your fellow Vault dwellers from dehydration.

## Features
- Skill-based system allowing you to fine-tune your character.
- Character growth through experience gained from combat, adventure seeds, and non-combat events.
- Tactical turn-based combat where players can take unlimited time for decisions.
- Variety of different types of attacks, weapons, and attack skills.

title: Assassin's Creed
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: April 8, 2008
- **Genre**: Action - Adventure - Historical
- **Developer**: Ubisoft Montreal
- **Publisher**: Ubisoft

## Overview
The game takes place in 1191 Jerusalem during the middle of the Third Crusade. While the player technically plays as Desmond Miles, the story focuses on Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad, a member of a mysterious order of assassins. As the growing influence of the Order of the Knights Templar threatens the Brotherhood, Altaïr is caught in a clash between two powerful organizations that triggers devastating events threatening the world.

## Features
- Well-constructed story that will pleasantly surprise you many times along the way.
- Impressive level of interaction with the environment – crowds react to what you do and act accordingly.
- Open world gameplay lets you decide how and when to achieve objectives, where to go, and gives you nearly complete freedom to get there.

title: Hello Neighbor Alpha

- **Genre**: Action - Adventure - Stealth
- **Developer**: Dynamic Pixels

## Overview
Hello Neighbor is a stealth horror game about sneaking into your neighbor's house to figure out what horrible secrets he is hiding in the basement. You play against an advanced AI that learns from your every move in a sandbox-style environment with plenty of environmental interaction and physics.

## Features
- Suspenseful horror gameplay (not jump scares) that focuses on sneaking around your neighbor's house
- Constantly evolving experience where the Neighbor's AI counters your moves, and learns from what you do
- Sandbox-style gameplay with plenty of environmental interaction and physics

title: IGI 2 Covert Strike
description:
## About Game
- **Release Date**: March 3, 2003
- **Genre**: Shooter - FPP - Stealth
- **Developer**: Innerloop Studios
- **Publisher**: Codemasters

## Overview
As the Cold War drew to a close, the world believed that peace would reign across the globe. It seemed that a new age had dawned, an age of lasting unity between nations, but this was not the case. Instead the fight for global supremacy had only been forced underground into the battlefield of covert ops and evil acts of terror. Into this arena sprung a new force. Masked behind the guises of subterfuge, plausible deniability and information management, the Institute for Geotactical Intelligence raised the sword against those who would subjugate the world. Though the malignancy of terrorism has broken our world on occasion, the global crucible has not yet boiled over into World War III. For that thank the one-man army David Jones and the forever-unsung heroes of IGI.

## Features
- A great first-person shooter with a touch of stealth
- Over 30 authentic weapons
- Create you own plan and find your own way through the challenging campaign

title: Project IGI 1: I'm Going In
description:
## About Game

**Release Date:** December 8, 2000  
**Genre:** Tactical Shooter, Stealth  
**Developer:** Innerloop Studios  
**Publisher:** Codemasters  

### Overview
IGI 1 (I'm Going In) is a tactical shooter that emphasizes realism and stealth over run-and-gun gameplay. Players assume the role of David Jones, a former British Special Forces operative, tasked with infiltrating enemy territory to thwart a global threat. With a focus on strategic planning, players must navigate through various missions using stealth, gadgets, and tactical skills to succeed.

### Features
- Realistic gameplay mechanics that prioritize stealth and strategy.  
- A variety of missions set in diverse environments, from snowy mountains to military bases.  
- Open-ended gameplay that allows multiple approaches to mission objectives.  
- A range of weapons and gadgets to aid in stealth operations.

title: GTA Vice City
description:
## About Game

**Release Date:** October 29, 2002  
**Genre:** Action-Adventure  
**Developer:** Rockstar North  
**Publisher:** Rockstar Games  

### Overview
GTA Vice City transports players to the vibrant, neon-lit streets of a fictional Miami during the 1980s. You play as Tommy Vercetti, a former mobster who, after being released from prison, seeks to establish himself in the criminal underworld. As he navigates the challenges of betrayal, power struggles, and the glitzy lifestyle of Vice City, players engage in a rich narrative filled with memorable characters and iconic missions.

### Features
- Expansive open-world environment set in a detailed 1980s-inspired city.  
- A diverse range of vehicles, including cars, motorcycles, and boats.  
- Engaging storyline with numerous side missions and activities.  
- Iconic soundtrack featuring a wide variety of 80s music.  
- Customizable properties and businesses to expand your criminal empire.
